english: Collecting a <void Void Breach /> causes your next instance of <void Void /> damage within 10 seconds to release a weakening burst, applying <void Weaken /> to enemies within 8 meters for 8 seconds.

source.text:
On Void Breach Pickup: 

The next Void Damage Instance within 10 seconds releases a weakening burst, inflicting Weaken to enemies within 8 metres.
